integrity: The result has an analytic proof, independent small-path exact enumeration, and reproducible finite diagnostics; no finite computation is used as evidence of an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-degree seedless infinite regular tree; initial local ancestry run only; no nonlocal-jump law or centered maximum limit. Earlier equivalences and priority are not certified independently.
title: Sharp factorial tails and an extreme-run law for nearest-predecessor genealogies
